description: Create a new empty diagram in a workspace, optionally inside a folder. Returns the new diagram's id. Use generate_diagram afterward to populate it with content. Use list_folders first to find the folder_id if you want to place it in a specific folder.

folder_id.description: Optional folder UUID to place the diagram in. Use list_folders to find folder ids. Omit to create at workspace root.

title.description: A short, descriptive title for the diagram (e.g. 'Auth Flow', 'System Architecture')

workspace_id.description: The workspace UUID to create the diagram in

name: create_diagram
